bd81f3571e.q: How should physical therapy practice partners divide work and responsibilities to avoid conflict?
bd81f3571e.a: Partners must define clear roles and responsibilities, staying in their own lanes while identifying decisions requiring both parties. Stephen Carter emphasized mutual respect for each skill set—clinical expertise versus business/financial expertise—and noted that having an aligned vision on roles, timelines, and plans over three to five years is essential, comparing partnership alignment to marriage preparation.

fb5ee2803e.q: What are the four stages of healthcare business growth in the HEAL framework?
fb5ee2803e.a: The HEAL framework consists of Hustle (organic passion-driven phase with minimal team), Establish (building processes and systems), Accelerate (scaling with team while maintaining profitability), and Lead (working on the business strategically, typically at three to five million dollars or more in revenue). Most private physical therapy practices do not reach the Lead stage, which is why Sterling and Stephen Carter wrote their book.

9587cd23f1.q: What are the top key performance indicators to track in a physical therapy clinic?
9587cd23f1.a: Top KPIs include referral conversion rates, patient utilization versus missed visits, and reimbursement rates by payer. Sterling and Stephen also track the number of calls answered, insurance authorization turnaround time, and patient graduation rates. They recommend three to five primary KPIs as the holy grail metrics, with real-time visibility and incentivization so employees know their top two to three KPIs daily.

fa8024a35e.q: Why did Sterling Physical Therapy shift from a one-therapist-with-tech model to a one-therapist-one-patient model?
fa8024a35e.a: They switched to a one therapist per patient model to increase quality and outcomes. Stephen noted that the previous model had one PT and a tech assigned to see multiple patients within a period of time, but the shift prioritized quality improvement, though the optimal model depends on geographic location and environmental factors specific to each clinic.

de4a0aa651.q: What must healthcare business owners demonstrate to lenders or investors for funding approval?
de4a0aa651.a: Lenders require strong personal credit as a first criterion and evidence of prior business experience in the healthcare sector. Stephen emphasized that if you lack good credit, securing funding becomes very difficult, and investors want to see that you have already worked successfully in the specific healthcare business area you are entering.
